QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_10

question.text: Under Regulation 29 of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, an AIF shall be wound up if investors pass a resolution at a meeting of unit-holders. The required consent threshold is:

answer.text: Simple majority (>50%) by value of investment
Two-thirds of unit-holders by value of investment
75% of investors by value of their investment

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 29 requires 75% of investors by value of investment to resolve winding-up of an AIF. The same 75% by-value threshold is used for in-specie distribution and dissolution-related approvals. The Trap: Simple majority is a corporate-governance default but is not the AIF wind-up threshold. Two-thirds (2/3) is the workbook's threshold for tenure extension - a frequent point of confusion. Unanimous consent is not required. Note: Distinguishing the 75% (wind-up / in-specie) threshold from the 2/3 (tenure extension) threshold is a common exam discrimination point.
